unitTitle: B1 · Talk about how things are done and what you experienced
title: Dialogues
subtitle: B1 · Unit 9: B1 · Talk about how things are done and what you experienced

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for each speaker's goal and the detail that changes the exchange. First read for meaning; then cover the English and summarize each person's point.

steps.title: Helping at an event
steps.body: Two volunteers describe how a fictional event was organized.

examples.fr: Les tables ont été installées avant notre arrivée.
examples.en: Nadia: The tables were set up before we arrived.

examples.fr: On les a préparés hier, puis ils ont été rangés à l'accueil.
examples.en: Nadia: They were prepared yesterday, then stored at reception.

examples.fr: En accueillant les participants, je vais vérifier leur inscription.
examples.en: Sam: While welcoming participants, I will check their registration.

examples.fr: Bonne idée. À la fin, on lira les commentaires ensemble.
examples.en: Nadia: Good idea. At the end, we will read the comments together.

steps.title: Describing a workshop
steps.body: A participant explains the steps to a new classmate.

examples.fr: L'atelier a été organisé par le centre communautaire.
examples.en: Lina: The workshop was organized by the community centre.

examples.fr: On remplit un court formulaire en ligne.
examples.en: Lina: You fill in a short online form.

examples.fr: Il est fourni sur place. En participant, tu rencontreras aussi les bénévoles.
examples.en: Lina: It is provided on site. By taking part, you will also meet the volunteers.
